evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Draws a categorical distinction to control how the reader frames the two concepts, an informational move without argued support.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Presents a reasoned contrast (commodity vs. asset) as if self-evident logic, a persuasion move via claimed distinction rather than authority.
